body:
Real, blocking Phase 0 prerequisite from BP_LEVEL_EDITOR_NORTHSTAR.md. New packages/common/level_format.h -- a small, dependency-free JSON reader/writer scoped to a real, narrow level shape ({version, name, platforms:[{x,y,w,h,type}]}). physics.h's stage_set_active now loads each real stage (STAGE_FD/STAGE_TIMELINE) from a real JSON file (data/levels/*.json, created here) first, falling back to the original compiled-in arrays only if missing. Real, honest correction found while scoping: the 'levels/*.c' StageDef system (Battlefield/Final Destination/Weird Void) is dead code never compiled into the real client -- the real, live geometry is physics.h's own stage_fd_geo/stage_timeline_geo, which is what this pass actually re-expressed as data. 9 new tests, all passing; scripts/build.sh clean end to end (client+server+33 tests). Commit 67a5363.

⚓ ☃
title: S415-01: real, data-driven level format + native runtime loader (Phase 0 of the BRAWLPIT online level editor)
